tableDescription: Night Shift table. Left flipper: Z or Left Shift. Right flipper: slash, M or Right Shift. Plunger: hold Space or the Down arrow, release to launch. Pause: P or Esc. On touch, press the left or right half of the table.
launchHint: Hold to charge the plunger, release to launch
paused: Paused — click or press P to continue
controlsIntro: Night Shift: keep the ball awake past midnight.

controlsList.left: Left flipper: Z or Left Shift
controlsList.right: Right flipper: / , M or Right Shift
controlsList.plunger: Plunger: hold Space or Down arrow, release to launch
controlsList.pause: Pause or resume: P or Esc
controlsList.touch: Touch or mouse: press the left or right half of the table to flip; hold Launch to charge the plunger

scoring: Coffee mugs 100 · keys 250 · spell C-O-D-E for a 2,000 bonus · desk lamp 500. Three balls per game.
newHighScore: New high score for this session!
